About the Team

At DoorDash we’re building the industry’s most scalable and reliable delivery network to support our three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and Dashers. Security Engineering is paramount to the success of our business, and DoorDash Security aspires to be one the world’s most admired Security Engineering team. We are committed to building the world's most trusted on-demand, logistics engine for delivery! We're expanding our team of great minds to help us secure and maintain a 24x7, no downtime, global infrastructure system that powers DoorDash’s multi-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and drivers.

About the Role

Our Proactive Security Engineering team is looking for a Staff Security Engineer, Proactive Security to execute on AI Security Product Engineering following a forward deployed engineering Pod model.

You will be a part of our inclusive, collaborative forward deployed engineering team responsible for building “paved road” Security Product controls directly into our AI surfaces for our Customer, Merchant and Dasher products to ensure a safe, secure and resilient delivery network. This is not a classic Product Security role performing reviews and operating platform products, this is a forward deployed model where we operate in Pods that focus on domain code bases to build and ship AI Security Products including Hardened Product Agents, AI Guardrails, MCP Gateways and many upcoming AI Hardening initiatives.

This is a US remote position reporting directly to the Manager of our Proactive Security Engineering team.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Co-lead the technical direction and roadmap for secure and responsible building of AI Security Products at DoorDash.
• Partner cross-functionally with Product Engineering, Legal, Security Engineering Platform, Data teams and XFN partners to build “paved road” proactive security controls that enable secure by design AI products into DoorDash eco-system. Examples of AI Security Products this team has built include Hardened Product Agents, AI Guardrails, MCP Gateways and many upcoming AI Hardening initiatives.
• Execute rigorous cross-brand AI enabled vulnerability discovery, multi-level harnesses and automated remediation to protect the company against Mythos-era equipped adversaries.
• Mentor and coach earlier career engineers, setting and enforcing exceptional standards for Operational Excellence and Software Engineering.

We’re excited about you because…

• 10+ years of experience as a Security Product Engineer at an Internet scale organization of demonstrated technical leadership building outcomes at global scale.
• Master’s degree in Computer Science, Security Engineering, a related field or equivalent work experience.
• Embed with product teams to design, build, and deploy security controls for consumer, merchant, and Dasher products.
• Develop reusable “paved road” solutions that help teams build secure AI products by default.
• Partner with Product Engineering, Legal, Data, Security Platform, and other teams to translate security and regulatory requirements into practical engineering controls.
• Demonstrated technical leadership in designing scalable, AI enabled and ergonomic Security Review threat modeling.
• Hands-on experience securing LLM or agentic systems, or demonstrated ability to move quickly into the space from adjacent depth in authorization, sandboxing, or untrusted input handling.
• Demonstrated builder in one or more object oriented languages (e.g. Go, Java) designing technical Security Engineering controls and processes to meet business and regulatory requirements.
• Exceptional problem solving of complex, systemic issues that require audacious thinking, rigor and creativity.

• Exceptional analytical and investigative abilities with hands-on experience leading root cause analysis for security incidents and driving long term roadmaps to remediate.

• Exceptional verbal and written communication skills - you will confidently shape and lead the Security Product Engineering within your assigned AI Security domain across core engineering and product teams to security preserving control outcomes.

Why You’ll Love Working at DoorDash

• We are leaders - Leadership is not limited to our management team. It’s something everyone at DoorDash embraces and embodies.
• We are doers - We believe the only way to predict the future is to build it. Creating solutions that will lead our company and our industry is what we do -- on every project, every day.
• We are learners - We’re not afraid to dig in and uncover the truth, even if it’s scary or inconvenient. Everyone here is continually learning on the job, no matter if we’ve been in a role for one year or one minute.

COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. TEAM OVERVIEW

KKR’s Marketing team develops executive content strategies that generate brand and product awareness to engage the firm’s clients with valuable content to meet quantifiable business goals. The team builds deep relationships with clients to bridge the gap between client interests and business goals, to create innovative content strategies. The team is also responsible for consistently investigating trends and best practices to make accurate and tailored recommendations to clients. The Marketing team closely collaborates with the sales, product strategy, and compliance teams.

POSITION DESCRIPTION

KKR is seeking a strategic, commercially minded, creative, and collaborative Vice President, Brand Strategy to support the development and advancement of brand strategy for KKR and our broader brand portfolio. This position is part of the Brand Marketing team within KKR Marketing and reports to the Head of Brand Marketing.

This role will help translate business priorities, market dynamics, and audience insights into clear brand strategies and plans that strengthen our brands and support broader business objectives. Working within the strategic direction of the Brand Marketing organization, the strategist will help positioning and messaging, and identify opportunities to strengthen brand relevance, differentiation, and impact globally for the enterprise brand as well as various business units

The role will serve as a strategic partner to stakeholders across Marketing and the broader organization, bringing structured thinking, insights, and recommendations to brand opportunities and challenges. The individual will work closely with teams across marketing as well as external agencies and partners, to translate strategy into compelling brand initiatives, messaging and experiences.

The ideal candidate combines strong strategic thinking with commercial judgment and creative instincts and can move fluidly from business challenge to insight, recommendation, and activation.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Brand Strategy & Planning

• Help define, evolve and extend KKR's enterprise brand strategy across KKR and our broader portfolio, ensuring it reflects the firm's vision, values, and competitive differentiation.
• Partner with KKR business teams to develop strategic positioning, value propositions, and messaging that align with the enterprise brand while meeting business-specific objectives. Help convert messaging frameworks into marketing assets including website, PowerPoint, video and social activations.
• Lead brand discovery sessions, messaging workshops, and stakeholder interviews to uncover differentiated insights.
• Manage relationships with brand research partners and use audience insights, competitive intelligence, and market and cultural trends to identify opportunities and inform brand strategy and decision-making.
• Develop strategic approaches for priority brand initiatives and campaigns, defining the business challenge, audience opportunity, strategic proposition, and measures of success.
• Support brand portfolio strategy and key brand decisions, including brand architecture, naming, positioning, partnerships, and sponsorships that carry implications for KKR's brands and reputation.
• Ensure consistency of the KKR brand across campaigns, content, experiences, and client touchpoints globally.
• Contribute to the continued development of the Brand Marketing function by strengthening strategic frameworks, planning tools, processes, and ways of working across the team.

Messaging & Storytelling

• Develop clear, compelling messaging frameworks for enterprise brand initiatives, investment strategies, business lines, campaigns, and executive communications.
• Write and refine high-impact copy and video scripts across a wide variety of channels, including websites, advertisements, content, campaigns, presentations, videos, thought leadership, brand narratives, and executive messaging.
• Distill complex investment concepts into simple, engaging, client-centric language.
• Establish messaging architecture, tone of voice, and narrative frameworks that can be adopted consistently across the organization.

Agency Leadership

• Serve as the primary day-to-day partner for brand strategy.
• Develop clear creative briefs and strategic direction that inspire best-in-class creative work.
• Challenge agencies to produce differentiated thinking while ensuring work reflects KKR's standards for quality and excellence.

Strategic Partnership

• Collaborate closely with marketing leaders, investment professionals, business leaders, and communications partners across the firm.
• Provide strategic counsel on branding, positioning, campaign development, and go-to-market initiatives.
• Influence stakeholders across multiple businesses and build alignment around strategic recommendations.

• Stay informed on market trends, competitor positioning, and evolving client expectations to identify opportunities for differentiation.

CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field.
• Significant experience in brand strategy, strategic planning, integrated marketing, or a related discipline, ideally gained through a combination of agency and in-house roles.
• Experience in an agency environment and/or within financial services, asset management, professional services, or another complex global organization preferred, with demonstrated ability to apply strategic brand thinking to business challenges.
• Demonstrated experience developing brand strategies, positioning, messaging, strategic briefs, and integrated marketing plans.
• Strong strategic and analytical capabilities, with the ability to synthesize complex business, audience, and market information into clear insights and actionable recommendations.
• Strong commercial judgment and intellectual curiosity, with the ability to understand business priorities and connect them to brand and marketing opportunities.
• Demonstrated ability to independently own strategic workstreams, develop recommendations, influence stakeholders, and drive work forward within a broader strategic direction.

• Strong emotional intelligence; ability to build trust and relationships with marketing team and broader employee base.

Team ASOBIでは、情熱と才能を持つ新進気鋭の3Dアーティストを募集しています。このポジションでは、当社のゲームに登場する高品質なキャラクターやプロップ、背景などの制作を担当していただきます。必要に応じて、デザインに対する考え方や文化的な視点、制作技術に関するトレーニングを受けていただきます。 前向きに学ぶ姿勢と高い意欲を持ち、責任感をもって仕事に取り組める方を歓迎します。

役割・職責：

• ゲームに必要な3Dモデルやテクスチャ、小物、背景など、各種アートアセットを制作します

• アート、ゲームデザイン、ゲームそのものに対する強い情熱を持っていること。

• 社交的で周囲と前向きに関わることができること。

Job title:
3D Artist

Experience Level:
All levels. No past game experience required.

Employment type:
Permanent or Contract-based.
Full-time (8 hours per day with some flexibility for time).

Reporting to:
Lead Artist

Studio & Department:
PlayStation Studios Team ASOBI / Art Team

Location:
Tokyo area (expected to work onsite).

Role overview:
Team ASOBI is looking for a passionate and talented upcoming 3D Artist. The ideal candidate will be responsible for creating high quality characters, props and environment for our games. Where needed, will provide training and coaching to teach design philosophies, cultural thinking and techniques. We expect a positive learning attitude, high motivation and great commitment.

Responsibilities:

• You will mostly create 3D models, textures, props, environments and other artistic elements needed for the game.
• You will also collaborate with other discipline members involved in the creation of a game to achieve the best user experience.
• Along the way, you will be required to learn many new general skills related to the development of a video game. An open mind will be crucial.

Skills required

• Passion for Art, game design, and gaming.
• Intermediate Japanese language skill.
• Good modeling in Maya / Zbrush or other equivalent software.
• Good texturing skills using substance painter and designer.
• Strong interest in cartoony, playful art style.
• Ability to work fast and autonomously.
• Attention to detail.
• Willingness and patience to learn with a respectful attitude.
• Social and outgoing personality.

Note:
You will be required to pass a practical test using your own time and resources. Please refrain from applying if you cannot meet these criteria.

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
